Before you print

  • No measuring needed. The speaker sits in the pocket by itself. The slot runs 25 to 155 mm behind the front edge on the centre line, which covers where the 1/4" insert is expected, and the screw is optional.
  • If you want to bolt it down, put the speaker on, look up through the slot to see the insert, and pick a 1/4"-20 screw about 10 mm longer than the stand is thick at that spot: roughly 24 mm near the front of the slot, 14 mm at the middle, 4 mm at the back. Thread it in by hand and stop if it gets hard.
  • Print two of the same part, one for the desk side and one for the shelf side.
  • The speaker in the view is a simple block at the real size (155 × 180 × 240 mm). The driver position is approximate.

The four round recesses on the underside are for self-adhesive rubber feet, so the stand does not slide on the desk or shelf.
